title: Fix Better Auth 500 Errors
description: The auth system returns HTTP 500 on `/api/auth/get-session` and other endpoints. Debug and fix the @convex-dev/better-auth integration with TanStack Start. Goal: admin-only magic link auth for etan@heyman.net.

currentFiles: convex/betterAuth.ts - Better Auth config with magic link plugin
src/routes/api/auth/$.tsx - TanStack route exposing auth API
knownIssues: Login page shows 'Loading...' forever because session check fails

acceptanceCriteria.text: Run `curl http://localhost:3001/api/auth/get-session` and verify it returns JSON (not 500)
Check Convex dashboard logs for any auth-related errors
Verify .env.local has VITE_CONVEX_URL, VITE_SITE_URL, and SITE_URL set correctly
If env vars are wrong, fix them and restart dev server
If handler is broken, check @convex-dev/better-auth docs for TanStack Start integration
Navigate to /login in browser - page loads without infinite 'Loading...'
Enter etan@heyman.net and click 'Send Magic Link'
Magic link URL appears in server console (since we're in dev mode)
Copy magic link URL and navigate to it in browser
After clicking magic link, user is redirected to / and session is active
Navigate back to /login - shows 'Welcome, Admin!' with sign out button
Click 'Sign Out' - session is cleared, returns to login form
Try entering wrong email (not etan@heyman.net) - shows 'Only admin email is allowed'

debuggingSteps: 1. Check if CONVEX_URL environment variable is set in Convex dashboard
2. Check if the auth HTTP handler is receiving requests (add console.log)
3. Check if the Convex function is being called (check Convex dashboard logs)
4. Verify the request format matches what convexBetterAuthReactStart expects
5. Check if there are CORS issues in browser console
6. Try calling the Convex auth functions directly to isolate the issue
